title: pollinia scoparia
intro: Pollinia scoparia, commonly known as Red Sandalwood, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and skin problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce stress, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality, attributed to its bioactive constituents like sandalwood oil and alkaloids like scopoletin and sandalol. The bioactive constituents present in Pollinia scoparia have been found to exhibit antioxidant, anti-bacterial, and anti-inflammatory activities, contributing to its medicinal value.
